name: BACH_0392
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (44%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Tier 3: low reliability [F6] and three-class conformal set (InSitu, Benign, Normal) [F1].

## Confidence
|Signal|Value|Reading|
|---|---|---|
|Top probabilities|InSitu 44%, Benign 28%, Normal 24%, Invasive 3%|Split across non-invasive classes|
|Conformal set|Normal, Benign, InSitu (90% coverage)|Non-invasive classes inseparable|
|Reliability / OOD|20% reliability (flagged), 94th percentile OOD|Suspect input; low trust|
|CONCH–MUSK agreement|Disagree on top class|Foundation models diverge|
|Similar cases|1/5 InSitu (20%), 3/5 Normal, 1/5 Invasive [F5]|Neighbors favor Normal|

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 3, 7, 11) · ↓ invasive · Top anti-invasive score; failed 0/20 AI spot checks [F2] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 7, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Strong anti-invasive score (20/20 spot checks) [F3] · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 1, 5) · ↓ invasive · Pushes against invasion; differs from Normal neighbor [F4] · Weak
- **Tumor cell fraction** (regions 4, 8, 9) · context · 90% neoplastic nuclei (100th percentile) [F7]; 3778/mm² density (97th) [F8] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top-risk regions drops invasive probability above random deletion (95% CI excludes 0).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion CI includes 0); leans on unreliable normal_lobules (0/20 spot checks).

## Could be wrong if
- Out-of-distribution quality (94th percentile) distorts features, or lesion is Normal/Benign (52% combined probability; 3/5 neighbors Normal).
- Focal invasion exists in region 4 (22% risk, 249 neoplastic nuclei) despite 3% slide invasive probability.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 4, 8, 9**: Inspect region 4 (22% risk, 249 neoplastic nuclei) to exclude invasion.
2. **Regions 1, 5**: Check duct-confined atypia versus hyperplasia; review drafted ER, CK5/6, deeper levels.
3. **Regions 3, 7, 10, 11**: Verify lobules/stroma; consider drafted H&E recut for low reliability.
